notes.title: 1.0.0 Full Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]We are proud to fully release 16BitSurvivors![/h1]
16BitSurvivors has been a wonderful chance for us to hone our skills and train our development process. We hope that you enjoy the final experience and look to our next titles and updates

It's been a cold 5 months, but we've pushed through the long nights and continued to develop 16BitSurvivors best we can. Happy New Year!

notes.title: v0.4.7 - Class Passives + Relics Complete!
notes.notes:
Moving into the New Year with a strong update. The relics are now complete, alongside the hearts and class passives. Next on the Development Sheet is "Synergies" & "Sound Design improvements". See you soon!

[h3]Fully Upgraded Relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Armoured Bust - Transform standard hearts into stronger Armoured Hearts
[*] Bloodskull - Turn excess damage into bloodlust, reducing cooldowns
[*] Bloody Die - Gain extra rerolls and luck by killing
[*] Final Ankh - Defy death itself
[*] Frostwalker - Leave a trail of chilling ice on the floor
[*] Glass Dagger - Avoid getting hit while increasing Damage
[*] Golden Scales - Earn more exp as you gain more gemstones
[*] Jellyfriend - Gain a protective jellyfish that stuns enemies that get too close
[*] Life Carrot - Increase Vision, dealing damage to those that walk in the light
[*] Loyal Shrimp - Carry a shrimp that donates to your wallet
[*] Rooted - Gain boosts while standing still
[*] Soulbomb - Shoot soul projectiles every X kills
[*] Status Dust - Increase Status Effect Length and Damage
[*] Torchlight - Randomly burn your enemies
[/list]

[h3]Character Class Passives Added[/h3]
Each class now has a passive effect to make them more distinct from each other. Unlock the passive from the skill tree.
[list]
[*] Blinding Light
[*] Built-In Armour
[*] Frostbite
[*] Greater Knowledge
[*] Immolation
[*] Lifesnap
[*] Potency
[*] Sacrifice
[/list]

[h3]Fully Upgraded Spell[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

[h3]New Hearts to Collect[/h3]

[*] Burning - Increase Damage

[*] Corrupted - Increase Damage, but corrupts all other hearts

notes.title: Early Access Summary
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Everyone![/h1]
This is our first Early Access Game. We want to prioritize consistent updates and transparency. Below is a summary of the current content and features within 16BitSurvivors, and what we intend to have complete by the big "1.0 Release".

Note: the total number of monsters, spells, classes, etc. is a prediction based on the assets we currently have access to. These numbers are subject to change

Save Data:
When updating 16BitSurvivors, we will always try to ensure save data can persist between updates. However, certain updates may require a data reset. We apologize for this inconvenience



[h1]Feature Summary[/h1]
[h3]Main Gameplay[/h3]
The core loop of 16BitSurvivors is complete: realtime combat with waves of enemies that increase in number and strength. After dying, the class is rewarded exp and any currency the player collected can be spent on upgrades for the next run.

[h3]Meta Progression[/h3]
Classes, Spells, Relics, Skill Nodes, and Maps can all be unlocked by fulfilling certain missions and/or spending in-game currency

[h3]Twitch Integration[/h3]
Chat can be displayed in-game, chatter's names can appear as miniboss titles, and chatters can type "!say" to make the main character type-speak in-game

[h3]Settings[/h3]
Gameplay, Screen, Audio, and Input toggles are all present



[h1]Content Summary[/h1]
[h3]Classes: 2/10[/h3]
Each class has their own spell and class-specific stat progression

[h3]Spells (Attacks): 5/20[/h3]
Each Spell has their own series of upgrades to be unlocked

[h3]Relics (Items): 5/25[/h3]
Each Relic has their own series of upgrades to be unlocked

[h3]Synergies: 0/15[/h3]
Synergies are implemented and ready to be added

[h3]Maps: 1/7[/h3]
Each Map Location has 3 difficulties to fight through
The Map selection section of the game will be enabled when more than one map exists

[h3]Bosses: 1/7[/h3]
The first map's boss is awaiting balancing and variations

[h3]Skills: 9/15[/h3]
Skills unlock features within the game and will be added as the game's features develop

[h1]Misc Notes[/h1]
Achievements will be disabled until the 1.0 release
Save Slots will be available at a later update
